_readme: A person's decisions about which judgment in the collection a library case is. Keys are the case_name exactly as Recourse prints it. Use {"doc_key": "c12345", "note": "why"} to say which judgment it is, or {"not_in_collection": "why"} to record that we do not hold it. The matcher reports a case as AMBIGUOUS_MATCH when it cannot tell; cards/MATCH_CHECK.csv lists them first.
